apihelp-deletedumps-example: Tani waa tusaale muujinaya sida loo tirtiro kayd-bixinnada.
apihelp-deletedumps-param-filename: Tirtir kayd-bixinta leh magaca faylkan la cayimay.
apihelp-deletedumps-param-type: Tirtir kayd-bixinta leh nooca la cayimay.
apihelp-generatedumps-example: Tani waa tusaale muujinaya sida loo abuuro kayd-bixinnada.
apihelp-generatedumps-param-type: Abuur kayd-bixinta leh nooca la cayimay.
apihelp-viewdumps-example-1: Tani waa tusaale muujinaya sida loo helo dhammaan kayd bixinnada.
apihelp-viewdumps-example-2: Tani waa tusaale muujinaya sida loo helo kayd-bixinnada nooca la cayimay ee 'xml'.
apihelp-viewdumps-param-filename: Hel kayd-bixinta leh magaca faylkan la cayimay.
apihelp-viewdumps-param-timestamp: Hel kayd-bixinta leh shaabaddan waqtiga la cayimay.
apihelp-viewdumps-param-type: Hel kayd-bixinta leh nooca la cayimay.
apihelp-viewdumps-summary: Eeg kayd-bixinnada nooca, magaca faylka ama shaabadda waqtiga la cayimay.
datadump-cannot-delete: Kayd-bixintan lama tirtiri karo sababtoo ah xaaladdeedu ma aha 'completed' ama 'failed'.
datadump-delete-failed: Kayd-bixinta la doortay lama tirtiri karin. Fadlan mar kale isku day.
datadump-desc: Waxaad abuuri kartaa noocyo kala duwan oo kayd-bixino ah. Hoos ka dooro ikhtiyaar si aad u abuurto kayd-bixin.
datadump-generated-disabled: Abuurista kayd-bixinnada hadda waa la joojiyey. Tani waxay noqon kartaa sababo la xiriira dayactir. Fadlan la xiriir maamulaha nidaamkaaga si aad u hesho macluumaad dheeraad ah.
datadump-generated-error: Kayd dhigista waa lagu guuldarraystay. Waxaad abuuri kartaa oo keliya $1 {{PLURAL:$1|kaydin|kaydino}}.
datadump-generated-success: Codsigaaga kayd dhigista waa la gudbiyay. Fadlan sug inta kayd-dhigista la abuurayo. Iyadoo ku xiran cabbirka kayd-dhigista, tani waxay qaadan kartaa ilaa dhowr saacadood.
datadump-log-header: Diiwaankani wuxuu raadraacaa dhammaan kayd-dhigisyada wiki-ga ee la tirtirayo ama lagu abuurayo [[Special:DataDump|DataDump]].
datadump-no-results: Wax kayd-dhigis ah lama helin, fadlan mid samee.
datadump-not-configured: DataDump lama qaabayn. Fadlan dib u eeg dukumentiyada kordhinta oo qaabee.
datadump-type-invalid: Nooca kayd-dhigista aad dooratay ma saxna. Fadlan u sheeg maamulaha nidaamkaaga in DataDump laga yaabo in si khaldan loo qaabeeyay.
datadump-view-desc: Waxaad arki kartaa liiska kayd-dhigisyada la abuuray oo aad soo dejisan kartaa, laakiin ma abuuri kartid kuwo cusub.
logentry-datadump-generate-completed: Abuurista kayd-dhigista cinwaankeedu yahay '$4' waa la dhammaystiray.
logentry-datadump-generate-failed: Dhibaato ayaa la kulantay intii lagu jiray abuurista kayd-dhigista '$4', waxaana kayd-dhigistii la joojiyay.
logentry-datadump-generate-in-progress: Abuurista kayd-dhigista cinwaankeedu yahay '$4' ayaa bilaabatay.
